messages.cli.help:
Z3-Launcher
No argument: graphical interface
Commands: check | setup | update | build | run | status
Options: --dir DIRECTORY --rom US_ROM
Example: z3-launcher setup --rom '/path/zelda3.sfc'

messages.help.General.Autosave: Save the game state on exit and restore it at the next start.
messages.help.General.DisplayPerfInTitle: Show performance information in the game window title.
messages.help.General.DisableFrameDelay: Disable the SDL delay between frames. This may improve performance on a display running at exactly 60 Hz.
messages.help.General.Language: Choose the game language. A supported ROM in that language is required to import its dialogue and font. This does not change the launcher language.
messages.help.Features.ItemSwitchLR: Use L and R to cycle through equipped items.
messages.help.Features.ItemSwitchLRLimit: Limit L/R item cycling to the first four items.
messages.help.Features.MirrorToDarkworld: Allow the Magic Mirror to travel in both directions between worlds.
messages.help.Features.CollectItemsWithSword: Collect nearby items by hitting them with the sword.
messages.help.Features.BreakPotsWithSword: Break pots with a level 2 or stronger sword.
messages.help.Features.DisableLowHealthBeep: Disable the warning sound when health is low.
messages.help.Features.SkipIntroOnKeypress: Allow a key press to skip the introduction.
messages.help.Features.ShowMaxItemsInYellow: Highlight rupees, arrows and bombs when their maximum count is reached.
messages.help.Features.MoreActiveBombs: Allow four active bombs instead of two.
messages.help.Features.CarryMoreRupees: Increase the wallet capacity to 9,999 rupees.
messages.help.Features.MiscBugFixes: Enable miscellaneous minor fixes in the game engine.
messages.help.Features.GameChangingBugFixes: Enable fixes that can change original gameplay behavior.
messages.help.Features.CancelBirdTravel: Allow cancelling bird travel with the X button.
messages.help.Graphics.WindowSize: Use Auto to follow the aspect ratio and scale, or enter widthxheight, for example 1280x720.
messages.help.Graphics.Fullscreen: Choose windowed, borderless fullscreen or exclusive fullscreen mode.
messages.help.Graphics.WindowScale: Set the window scale: 1 is 100%, 2 is 200%, and so on.
messages.help.Graphics.OutputMethod: Choose the rendering backend. OpenGL shaders require an OpenGL renderer.
messages.help.Graphics.NewRenderer: Use the optimized SNES PPU implementation. Rendering can differ from the original implementation.
messages.help.Graphics.EnhancedMode7: Render the world map at a higher resolution.
messages.help.Graphics.IgnoreAspectRatio: Stretch the image to fill the window or screen regardless of its aspect ratio.
messages.help.Graphics.NoSpriteLimits: Remove the original sprite limit per scanline.
messages.help.Graphics.LinearFiltering: Smooth the image with linear filtering; pixels become less sharp.
messages.help.Graphics.DimFlashes: Reduce bright flashes in the game.
messages.help.Graphics.LinkGraphics: Choose a custom Link sprite in ZSPR format. Leave empty to use the original sprite.
messages.help.Graphics.Shader: Choose a .glsl shader or .glslp preset. OpenGL rendering is required. The picker starts in the installed shader library.
messages.help.Sound.EnableAudio: Enable sound output from the game.
messages.help.Sound.AudioChannels: Mono sends the same sound to both channels; stereo uses left and right positioning.
messages.help.Sound.AudioFreq: Set the audio sample rate. MSU PCM requires 44,100 Hz; OPUZ requires 48,000 Hz.
messages.help.Sound.AudioSamples: Set the audio buffer size in samples. Smaller buffers reduce latency but can cause interruptions.
messages.help.Sound.EnableMSU: Choose the external music format. Music files must be installed separately.
messages.help.Sound.ResumeMSU: Resume external music at its previous position when returning to an area.
messages.help.Sound.MSUVolume: Set external music volume from 0 to 100 percent.
messages.help.Sound.MSUPath: Enter the music filename prefix, including its directory. This is not just a folder path.
messages.help.aspect.ratio: Choose the rendering aspect ratio. 4:3 is the original format; wider formats can still show side bars in some scenes.
messages.help.aspect.extend: Display 240 vertical lines instead of the original 224.
messages.help.aspect.sprites: Keep original sprite spawning and disappearance behavior, important for replay compatibility.
messages.help.aspect.fixes: Disable visual glitch fixes. This can affect memory comparison with the original game.
messages.help.binding.Controls: Assign this SNES control. Keyboard and controller bindings are independent.
messages.help.binding.Pause: Pause the game without opening the in-game menu.
messages.help.binding.PauseDimmed: Pause the game and dim the image.
messages.help.binding.WindowBigger: Increase window scale by one step.
messages.help.binding.WindowSmaller: Decrease window scale by one step.
messages.help.binding.CheatLife: Restore health. Hold Shift when activating to refill other resources as supported by the game.
messages.help.binding.CheatKeys: Give one key when you have none.
messages.help.binding.CheatWalkThroughWalls: Enable or disable walking through walls.
messages.help.binding.Turbo: Run the game at an accelerated speed.
messages.help.binding.ReplayTurbo: Toggle between normal and accelerated replay speed.
messages.help.binding.ToggleRenderer: Switch between the original and optimized PPU renderers.
messages.help.binding.DisplayPerf: Toggle the display of performance information.
messages.help.binding.Load: Load the game state from this slot.
messages.help.binding.Save: Save the game state to this slot.
messages.help.binding.Replay: Start replay playback for this slot.
messages.help.action.capture: Wait for a key or controller input for up to 15 seconds. Escape cancels capture.
messages.help.action.assign_all: Capture each SNES control in sequence. Escape stops the sequence.
messages.help.action.preset: Apply the keyboard preset; the configuration is saved automatically.
messages.help.action.ini: Open the configuration file in the system editor. Saved changes are automatically reflected in the launcher.
messages.help.action.reload: Reload settings from the configuration file.
messages.help.action.reimport: Select the language ROM again and regenerate dialogue, fonts and game resources.
messages.help.launcher.check: Check dependencies and show missing packages with an installation command for your distribution. Nothing is installed automatically.
messages.help.launcher.setup: Verify the US ROM, update or clone the game and install missing GLSL shaders, clean compiled output, extract resources and rebuild Zelda 3.
messages.help.launcher.run: Launch the compiled game with the current saved configuration.
messages.help.launcher.rom: Select or drop a compatible US .sfc or .smc ROM to build the base game.
messages.help.launcher.workspace: Directory containing the game repository and launcher log. Fixed automatically in portable mode.
messages.help.launcher.language: Choose the launcher interface language. This is independent of the game language.
messages.shaders.invalid_format: Choose a .glsl or .glslp shader, or leave the shader path empty.
messages.settings.editor_opened: INI opened in the system editor. Saved changes will be reloaded automatically.
messages.settings.editor_failed: Could not open the INI editor: {error}
messages.settings.external_reloaded: Settings reloaded from the externally edited INI.
messages.settings.external_invalid: The externally edited INI has invalid settings: {error}
messages.shaders.requires_opengl: Choose OpenGL or OpenGL ES as the renderer to configure shaders.
messages.settings.ini_hint: Changes are saved automatically when you leave this tab. The launcher settings are then refreshed.
messages.settings.ini_saved: INI file saved; launcher settings updated.
